commit.message: Implement B v2 geometry, passage routes and annotated vehicle logs

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,418 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Publish eight completed B v2 MP4s unchanged using the native Actions token.
+
+The dispatched commit contains the retained delivery manifest. The separately
+bound executed commit produced the Kaggle outputs and becomes the release tag
+target. No encoding, model, identity resolution, or counting occurs here.
+Signed Kaggle download capabilities are masked immediately and never retained.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
+from urllib.parse import urlsplit
+from urllib.request import HTTPRedirectHandler, Request, build_opener
+
+
+REPOSITORY = "unChris666/traffic-vehicle-counter-IDM-LOC"
+EVENT_TYPE = "phase8-publish-b-v2-v1"
+TAG = "phase8-b-v2-tgdi-review-v1"
+DOWNLOAD_HOST = "www.kaggleusercontent.com"
+MANIFEST_PATH = Path("results/b_v2/delivery_manifest.json")
+VIDEO_IDS = tuple(f"{day}_{period}" for day in ("weekday", "weekend")
+                  for period in ("pagi", "siang", "sore", "malam"))
+REQUIRED_SOURCE_FILES = frozenset((
+    "notebooks/phase_8_b_v2_counting.py", "notebooks/phase_8_b_v2_annotation.py",
+    "notebooks/phase_8_b_v2_batch.py", "notebooks/phase_5_geometry_helpers.py",
+    "notebooks/phase_8_annotation_helpers.py", "notebooks/phase_8_annotation_batch.py"))
+
+
+class PublicationError(Exception):
+    """Diagnostics must contain no credential, response body, or signed URL."""
+
+
+def require(condition, message):
+    if not condition:
+        raise PublicationError(message)
+
+
+def now():
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def sha256(path):
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with Path(path).open("rb") as source:
+        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def write_json(path, value):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def command(arguments, *, body=None, expect_json=False):
+    result = subprocess.run(arguments, input=None if body is None else json.dumps(body),
+                            text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+    require(result.returncode == 0, f"Command failed: {Path(arguments[0]).name}, exit={result.returncode}")
+    return json.loads(result.stdout) if expect_json else result.stdout
+
+
+def api(endpoint, *, method="GET", body=None, allow_missing=False):
+    arguments = ["gh", "api", "--method", method, endpoint]
+    if body is not None:
+        arguments.extend(["--input", "-"])
+    if not allow_missing:
+        return command(arguments, body=body, expect_json=method != "DELETE")
+    require(method == "GET" and body is None, "Missing-resource allowance only supports GET")
+    result = subprocess.run(arguments, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+    if result.returncode == 0:
+        return json.loads(result.stdout)
+    require(re.search(r"\bHTTP 404\b", result.stderr) is not None,
+            "Could not verify absence of a GitHub resource")
+    return None
+
+
+def _hex(value, length, label):
+    require(isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(f"[0-9a-f]{{{length}}}", value) is not None,
+            label + " requires a full lowercase hexadecimal SHA")
+    return value
+
+
+def _integer(value, label, minimum=0):
+    require(type(value) is int and value >= minimum, label + " must be an integer")
+    return value
+
+
+def validate_url(value, *, mask=False):
+    require(isinstance(value, str) and value and not any(ord(char) < 32 or ord(char) == 127 for char in value),
+            "Invalid signed-download URL value")
+    if mask:
+        print("::add-mask::" + value.replace("%", "%25"), flush=True)
+    parsed = urlsplit(value)
+    require(parsed.scheme == "https" and parsed.netloc == DOWNLOAD_HOST and parsed.hostname == DOWNLOAD_HOST
+            and parsed.username is None and parsed.password is None and not parsed.fragment,
+            "Download URL requires the exact approved HTTPS host")
+    return value
+
+
+class NoRedirects(HTTPRedirectHandler):
+    def redirect_request(self, request, file_pointer, code, message, headers, new_url):
+        return None
+
+
+def validate_payload_manifest(payload, manifest, *, mask_urls=False):
+    require(isinstance(payload, dict) and isinstance(manifest, dict), "Payload and manifest must be objects")
+    delivery_commit = _hex(payload.get("source_commit"), 40, "Delivery commit")
+    require(manifest.get("schema_version") == "phase8_b_v2_delivery_v1", "Unexpected delivery schema")
+    require(manifest.get("repository") == REPOSITORY, "Unexpected delivery repository")
+    executed_commit = _hex(manifest.get("source_commit"), 40, "Executed code commit")
+    if "executed_source_commit" in manifest:
+        require(manifest["executed_source_commit"] == executed_commit, "Executed source aliases differ")
+    # A capability must never be copied into retained manifest fields.
+    require(DOWNLOAD_HOST not in json.dumps(manifest).lower(), "Retained manifest contains a signed-download host")
+    rows, assets = payload.get("downloads"), manifest.get("assets")
+    require(isinstance(rows, list) and len(rows) == 8 and all(isinstance(row, dict) for row in rows),
+            "Exactly eight download objects are required")
+    require({row.get("video_id") for row in rows} == set(VIDEO_IDS), "Download video IDs differ")
+    urls = {row["video_id"]: validate_url(row.get("url"), mask=mask_urls) for row in rows}
+    require(isinstance(assets, list) and len(assets) == 8 and all(isinstance(asset, dict) for asset in assets),
+            "Exactly eight retained video assets are required")
+    require({asset.get("video_id") for asset in assets} == set(VIDEO_IDS), "Manifest video IDs differ")
+    by_id, plan = {asset["video_id"]: asset for asset in assets}, []
+    for video_id in VIDEO_IDS:
+        asset = by_id[video_id]
+        day, period = video_id.split("_")
+        expected_name = f"TGDI-{day.upper()}-{period.upper()}-b-v2-annotated.mp4"
+        require(asset.get("filename") == expected_name, "Unexpected or unsafe MP4 filename")
+        _hex(asset.get("sha256"), 64, "MP4 SHA")
+        size = _integer(asset.get("size_bytes"), "MP4 size", 1)
+        require(size < 2 * 1024 ** 3, "MP4 exceeds the per-asset delivery bound")
+        _integer(asset.get("frame_count"), "MP4 frame count", 1)
+        total = _integer(asset.get("operational_total"), "Operational total")
+        measured = _integer(asset.get("measured_total"), "Measured total")
+        inferred = _integer(asset.get("inferred_total"), "Inferred total")
+        require(measured + inferred == total, "Measured/inferred counts do not reconcile")
+        source_path = asset.get("source_output_path")
+        require(isinstance(source_path, str) and source_path.endswith(".mp4")
+                and ".." not in PurePosixPath(source_path).parts
+                and not any(ord(char) < 32 for char in source_path) and "://" not in source_path
+                and "?" not in source_path and "#" not in source_path, "Invalid retained output path")
+        plan.append(dict(asset, url=urls[video_id]))
+    require(sum(asset["frame_count"] for asset in plan) == 72590, "Unexpected full TGDI frame total")
+    files = manifest.get("executed_source_files")
+    require(isinstance(files, list) and len(files) == 6 and all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in files),
+            "Six executed source bindings are required")
+    require({item.get("path") for item in files} == REQUIRED_SOURCE_FILES, "Executed source file set differs")
+    for item in files:
+        _hex(item.get("sha256"), 64, "Executed source file SHA")
+    return delivery_commit, executed_commit, plan
+
+
+def verify_source_binding(root, delivery_commit, executed_commit, manifest):
+    require(command(["git", "-C", str(root), "rev-parse", "HEAD"]).strip() == delivery_commit,
+            "Checked-out delivery commit differs")
+    ancestor = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", executed_commit,
+                               delivery_commit], capture_output=True, check=False)
+    require(ancestor.returncode == 0, "Executed source is not retained in delivery history")
+    for item in manifest["executed_source_files"]:
+        require(sha256(root / item["path"]) == item["sha256"], "Checked-out executed source SHA differs")
+        original = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), "show", f"{executed_commit}:{item['path']}"],
+                                  capture_output=True, check=False)
+        require(original.returncode == 0 and hashlib.sha256(original.stdout).hexdigest() == item["sha256"],
+                "Executed-commit source SHA differs")
+    remote = api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/commits/{executed_commit}")
+    require(remote.get("sha") == executed_commit, "Executed commit unavailable in expected repository")
+
+
+def require_unused_tag(tag):
+    # Authenticated release listing includes drafts, while /releases/tags can
+    # return 404 for a draft whose tag has not been created yet.
+    page = 1
+    while True:
+        releases = api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/releases?per_page=100&page={page}")
+        require(isinstance(releases, list), "Invalid release listing")
+        require(not any(release.get("tag_name") == tag for release in releases),
+                "A release or draft already exists; refusing to replace it")
+        if len(releases) < 100:
+            break
+        page += 1
+    require(api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/releases/tags/{tag}", allow_missing=True) is None,
+            "Release already exists; refusing to replace it")
+    require(api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/git/ref/tags/{tag}", allow_missing=True) is None,
+            "Tag already exists; refusing to replace it")
+
+
+def verify_remote_asset(asset, path):
+    expected_sha, expected_size = sha256(path), path.stat().st_size
+    require(asset.get("name") == path.name and asset.get("state") == "uploaded"
+            and asset.get("size") == expected_size, "Uploaded asset size, name, or state differs")
+    if asset.get("digest") is not None:
+        require(asset["digest"] == "sha256:" + expected_sha, "GitHub asset SHA differs")
+        method = "GITHUB_SERVER_SHA256"
+    else:
+        process = subprocess.Popen(["gh", "api", f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/releases/assets/{asset['id']}",
+                                    "-H", "Accept: application/octet-stream"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                                   stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+        digest, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
+        assert process.stdout is not None
+        for block in iter(lambda: process.stdout.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+            count += len(block)
+        require(process.wait() == 0 and count == expected_size and digest.hexdigest() == expected_sha,
+                "Downloaded GitHub asset SHA differs")
+        method = "ACTUAL_GITHUB_ASSET_DOWNLOAD_SHA256"
+    return {"id": asset["id"], "name": asset["name"], "size_bytes": expected_size,
+            "sha256": expected_sha, "github_digest": asset.get("digest"), "state": asset["state"],
+            "verification_method": method, "browser_download_url": asset["browser_download_url"]}
+
+
+def upload_probe(executed_commit, work, run_id, attempt):
+    tag = f"phase8-b-v2-upload-check-{run_id}-{attempt}"
+    require_unused_tag(tag)
+    probe_dir = work / "probe"
+    probe_dir.mkdir()
+    path = probe_dir / "SHA256SUMS"
+    path.write_text(hashlib.sha256(f"B v2 upload probe {run_id}/{attempt}".encode()).hexdigest() + "  probe\n")
+    created = api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/releases", method="POST", body={
+        "tag_name": tag, "target_commitish": executed_commit, "name": "Temporary B v2 upload authorization probe",
+        "body": "Checksum-only owned draft; no video or inference execution.", "draft": True})
+    release_id = created["id"]
+    require(created.get("tag_name") == tag and created.get("draft") is True, "Unexpected probe identity")
+    proof = {"claim_type": "ACTUAL_NATIVE_ACTIONS_TOKEN_CHECKSUM_UPLOAD_PROBE", "recorded_at_utc": now(),
+             "temporary_draft_id": release_id, "temporary_tag": tag, "bulk_download_started": False,
+             "token_value_retained": False}
+    try:
+        command(["gh", "release", "upload", tag, str(path), "--repo", REPOSITORY])
+        current = api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/releases/{release_id}")
+        require(len(current["assets"]) == 1, "Unexpected probe assets")
+        proof["verified_checksum_upload"] = verify_remote_asset(current["assets"][0], path)
+        proof["status"] = "UPLOAD_AUTHORIZATION_VERIFIED"
+    finally:
+        current = api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/releases/{release_id}")
+        require(current.get("id") == release_id and current.get("tag_name") == tag and current.get("draft") is True
+                and len(current["assets"]) <= 1 and all(asset["name"] == path.name for asset in current["assets"]),
+                "Refusing to delete a draft with unexpected probe identity")
+        api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/releases/{release_id}", method="DELETE")
+        require(api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/releases/{release_id}", allow_missing=True) is None,
+                "Owned probe draft cleanup not verified")
+        proof["temporary_owned_draft_deleted"] = True
+        write_json(work / "credential_verification.json", proof)
+    return proof
+
+
+def download_one(item, destination):
+    path = destination / item["filename"]
+    partial = path.with_suffix(".mp4.downloading")
+    require(not path.exists() and not partial.exists(), "Download destination already exists")
+    started, count, digest = time.perf_counter(), 0, hashlib.sha256()
+    request = Request(item["url"], headers={"User-Agent": "phase8-b-v2-publication/1", "Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
+    try:
+        with build_opener(NoRedirects()).open(request, timeout=180) as response, partial.open("xb") as output:
+            require(response.status == 200 and response.geturl() == item["url"], "Download HTTP status or origin differs")
+            length = response.headers.get("Content-Length")
+            if length is not None:
+                require(length.isdecimal() and int(length) == item["size_bytes"], "Download content length differs")
+            for block in iter(lambda: response.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+                count += len(block)
+                require(count <= item["size_bytes"], "MP4 exceeds retained byte size")
+                digest.update(block)
+                output.write(block)
+    except HTTPError as error:
+        raise PublicationError(f"Completed Kaggle output download HTTP status={error.code}") from None
+    except URLError:
+        raise PublicationError("Completed Kaggle output download network failure") from None
+    require(count == item["size_bytes"] and digest.hexdigest() == item["sha256"], "Kaggle output SHA or size differs")
+    partial.replace(path)
+    return {"video_id": item["video_id"], "filename": path.name, "sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
+            "size_bytes": count, "http_status": 200, "wall_seconds": time.perf_counter() - started,
+            "download_url_or_secret_retained": False}
+
+
+def publish(root, manifest_path, manifest, plan, delivery_commit, executed_commit, work, probe_proof):
+    require_unused_tag(TAG)
+    video_dir = work / "videos"
+    video_dir.mkdir()
+    downloaded = []
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
+        futures = {executor.submit(download_one, item, video_dir): item["video_id"] for item in plan}
+        for future in as_completed(futures):
+            record = future.result()
+            downloaded.append(record)
+            print(json.dumps({"stage": "retained_mp4_verified", "video_id": record["video_id"]}), flush=True)
+    delivered_manifest = work / "delivery_manifest.json"
+    shutil.copyfile(manifest_path, delivered_manifest)
+    checksums = work / "SHA256SUMS"
+    checksums.write_text("".join(f"{item['sha256']}  {item['filename']}\n" for item in plan)
+                         + f"{sha256(delivered_manifest)}  delivery_manifest.json\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    notes = ("Eight completed TGDI B v2 annotated MP4 outputs from Kaggle, unchanged.\n\n"
+             "Operational totals include measured and inferred passages, explicitly separated in the videos and manifest. "
+             "Timeout counts are estimates and do not prove an ID change. No accuracy claim.\n\n"
+             "Publication performs only SHA-bound transport; detector, tracker, ReID, counting and encoding are not rerun.\n\n"
+             f"Executed code: `{executed_commit}`. Delivery manifest/publisher: `{delivery_commit}`.\n")
+    created = api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/releases", method="POST", body={"tag_name": TAG,
+        "target_commitish": executed_commit, "name": "Phase 8 B v2 — TGDI annotated review v1",
+        "body": notes, "draft": True, "prerelease": True})
+    release_id = created["id"]
+    require(created.get("tag_name") == TAG and created.get("draft") is True, "Unexpected delivery draft")
+    files = [video_dir / item["filename"] for item in plan] + [delivered_manifest, checksums]
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
+        futures = [executor.submit(command, ["gh", "release", "upload", TAG, str(path), "--repo", REPOSITORY])
+                   for path in files]
+        for future in as_completed(futures):
+            future.result()
+    draft = api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/releases/{release_id}")
+    draft_assets = {asset["name"]: asset for asset in draft["assets"]}
+    require(len(draft_assets) == 10 and set(draft_assets) == {path.name for path in files}, "Unexpected draft asset set")
+    for path in files:
+        verify_remote_asset(draft_assets[path.name], path)
+    api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/releases/{release_id}", method="PATCH", body={"draft": False})
+    # Only the final API snapshot supplies links. Draft download URLs can use a
+    # temporary untagged prefix and must never become the retained public index.
+    final = api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/releases/{release_id}")
+    require(final.get("draft") is False and final.get("tag_name") == TAG
+            and final.get("target_commitish") == executed_commit, "Published release/source differs")
+    resolved = api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/commits/{TAG}")
+    require(resolved.get("sha") == executed_commit, "Published tag resolves to another executed commit")
+    final_assets = {asset["name"]: asset for asset in final["assets"]}
+    verified = []
+    for path in files:
+        record = verify_remote_asset(final_assets[path.name], path)
+        expected_url = f"https://github.com/{REPOSITORY}/releases/download/{TAG}/{path.name}"
+        require(record["browser_download_url"] == expected_url, "Final asset URL does not use the published tag")
+        verified.append(record)
+    receipt = {"schema_version": "phase8_b_v2_publication_receipt_v1",
+        "claim_type": "ACTUAL_FINAL_GITHUB_RELEASE_PUBLICATION_NOT_MODEL_EVALUATION", "recorded_at_utc": now(),
+        "repository": REPOSITORY, "release_id": release_id, "tag_name": TAG, "html_url": final["html_url"],
+        "draft": False, "published_at": final["published_at"], "executed_source_commit": executed_commit,
+        "delivery_source_commit": delivery_commit, "resolved_tag_commit_sha": resolved["sha"],
+        "workflow_run_id": os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ID"], "workflow_run_attempt": os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT", "1"),
+        "workflow_url": f"https://github.com/{REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/{os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID']}",
+        "delivery_manifest_sha256": sha256(delivered_manifest), "video_asset_count": 8,
+        "assets": [dict(record, video_id=next(item["video_id"] for item in plan if item["filename"] == record["name"]))
+                   for record in verified if record["name"].endswith(".mp4")],
+        "supplemental_assets": [record for record in verified if not record["name"].endswith(".mp4")],
+        "expected_final_release_asset_count": 11, "receipt_self_digest_excluded": True,
+        "credential_verification": probe_proof, "verified_kaggle_downloads": sorted(downloaded, key=lambda item: item["video_id"]),
+        "executed_source_files": manifest["executed_source_files"], "frame_total": sum(item["frame_count"] for item in plan),
+        "operational_total": sum(item["operational_total"] for item in plan),
+        "measured_total": sum(item["measured_total"] for item in plan), "inferred_total": sum(item["inferred_total"] for item in plan),
+        "new_detector_tracker_reid_counting_or_encoding_execution": False, "signed_download_urls_retained": False,
+        "videos_committed_to_git": False}
+    receipt_path = work / "publication_receipt.json"
+    write_json(receipt_path, receipt)
+    command(["gh", "release", "upload", TAG, str(receipt_path), "--repo", REPOSITORY])
+    last = api(f"repos/{REPOSITORY}/releases/{release_id}")
+    require(len(last["assets"]) == 11 and {asset["name"] for asset in last["assets"]}
+            == {path.name for path in files} | {receipt_path.name}, "Final release asset count differs")
+    receipt_asset = next(asset for asset in last["assets"] if asset["name"] == receipt_path.name)
+    verified_receipt = verify_remote_asset(receipt_asset, receipt_path)
+    require(verified_receipt["browser_download_url"]
+            == f"https://github.com/{REPOSITORY}/releases/download/{TAG}/{receipt_path.name}",
+            "Receipt URL does not use the published tag")
+    print(json.dumps({"status": "PUBLISHED", "release_url": final["html_url"], "verified_videos": 8,
+                      "receipt_sha256": sha256(receipt_path), "executed_source_commit": executed_commit,
+                      "delivery_source_commit": delivery_commit}), flush=True)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--validate-only", action="store_true", help="Validate retained manifest/payload without network or mutation")
+    parser.add_argument("--payload", type=Path, help="Local validation payload; only accepted with --validate-only")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
+    if args.validate_only:
+        require(args.payload is not None, "Local validation needs --payload")
+        payload = json.loads(args.payload.read_text())
+        manifest = json.loads((root / MANIFEST_PATH).read_text())
+        delivery, executed, plan = validate_payload_manifest(payload, manifest)
+        print(json.dumps({"status": "LOCAL_VALIDATION_PASS_NO_NETWORK_OR_MUTATION", "videos": len(plan),
+                          "delivery_source_commit": delivery, "executed_source_commit": executed}))
+        return
+    require(args.payload is None, "Local payload paths are only allowed in validate-only mode")
+    require(os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS") == "true" and os.environ.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY") == REPOSITORY,
+            "Publisher requires the expected repository's GitHub Actions runtime")
+    require(bool(os.environ.get("GH_TOKEN")), "Native Actions token missing")
+    run_id, attempt = os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID", ""), os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT", "1")
+    require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", run_id) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", attempt), "Invalid workflow run identity")
+    event = json.loads(Path(os.environ["GITHUB_EVENT_PATH"]).read_text())
+    require(event.get("action") == EVENT_TYPE, "Unexpected dispatch event type")
+    payload = event.get("client_payload")
+    # Mask capabilities before any manifest/source/network validation can fail.
+    if isinstance(payload, dict) and isinstance(payload.get("downloads"), list):
+        for row in payload["downloads"]:
+            if isinstance(row, dict):
+                validate_url(row.get("url"), mask=True)
+    manifest_path = root / MANIFEST_PATH
+    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
+    delivery, executed, plan = validate_payload_manifest(payload, manifest)
+    verify_source_binding(root, delivery, executed, manifest)
+    require_unused_tag(TAG)
+    work = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / f"phase8-b-v2-publication-{run_id}-{attempt}"
+    require(not work.exists(), "Publication working directory already exists")
+    work.mkdir()
+    print(json.dumps({"stage": "checksum_upload_authorization_probe"}), flush=True)
+    proof = upload_probe(executed, work, run_id, attempt)
+    print(json.dumps({"stage": "upload_authorization_verified_before_bulk_download"}), flush=True)
+    publish(root, manifest_path, manifest, plan, delivery, executed, work, proof)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        main()
+    except Exception as error:
+        message = str(error) if isinstance(error, PublicationError) else "Unexpected failure; signed URLs and response bodies withheld"

+# Kontrak eksperimen counting B v2
+
+Status: perubahan yang diminta pengguna untuk replay pengukuran Phase 8 yang sudah tersimpan. Kontrak ini mendefinisikan perilaku perangkat lunak; bukan hasil delapan video, bukti akurasi, atau persetujuan produksi. Kebijakan, kode, event, dan bukti B v1 tetap menjadi pembanding historis yang terpisah.
+
+## 1. Keputusan pengguna dan sumber geometri
+
+**REQUIREMENT — pengguna:** geometri dari `TGDI-WEEKDAY-PAGI-geometry-review.json` menjadi acuan seluruh delapan video TGDI. Sumber asli disimpan tanpa mengubah byte pada [input geometri](../results/b_v2/input/TGDI-WEEKDAY-PAGI-geometry-review.json). File tersebut merupakan ekspor editor sebelumnya; flag bahwa counting belum disetujui di dalam ekspor adalah provenance waktu ekspor, bukan pembatalan permintaan implementasi pengguna yang datang sesudahnya.
+
+**FACT:** delapan sumber TGDI yang sudah retained berukuran 640×480. Konfigurasi turunan per video mengikat template yang sama dengan identitas dan SHA sumber masing-masing pada [geometry manifest](../results/b_v2/config/geometry_manifest.json). Penerapan ke delapan video ini diizinkan pengguna; kesesuaian sepanjang waktu tetap perlu diperiksa dari replay.
+
+- Ruang koordinat: pixel native frame penuh, origin kiri atas, x ke kanan, y ke bawah.
+- Garis menggunakan endpoint asli pada JSON: P1≈(1,6844; 429,9945), P2≈(617,3266; 1,3159). Pembulatan pada kalimat ini hanya untuk pembaca; konfigurasi menyimpan presisi sumber.
+- Margin adalah **half-width 25 pixel**, tegak lurus garis; lebar total pita **50 pixel**.
+- Pita berbentuk persegi panjang dengan ujung datar, terbatas pada proyeksi P1–P2. Perpanjangan garis tak terbatas tidak menjadi bukti crossing segmen.
+- Polygon A/B memakai semua vertex dalam lampiran tanpa penyesuaian diam-diam. Batas polygon netral menurut implementasi geometri yang digunakan.
+- `A_TO_B` berarti mendekati kamera; `B_TO_A` berarti menjauhi kamera, mengikuti pemetaan TGDI yang sudah dikonfirmasi.
+
+Kendaraan dapat berpindah sisi garis tak terbatas di luar endpoint jika lintasannya atau ROI berada di luar cakupan segmen. Jalur kendaraan di jalan tidak membuktikan setiap BC selalu memotong segmen yang dipilih. Pemeriksaan finite segment tetap diperlukan.
+
+## 2. Unit, anchor, dan asumsi identitas
+
+**REQUIREMENT — pengguna:** motorcycle bersama rider/passenger adalah satu motorcycle. Bbox gabungan dipakai untuk menampilkan komponen yang sudah terasosiasi sebagai satu unit. Rider tidak menambah hitungan.
+
+**REQUIREMENT:** anchor counting tetap bottom-center bbox **kendaraan mentah yang diukur**, terhubung langsung ke deteksi sumber dan emitted track. Bbox gabungan tampilan, rider BC, prediksi tracker, dan rata-rata beberapa bbox tidak mengganti anchor tersebut.
+
+**ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION:** untuk kendaraan yang tidak mempunyai grouping yang didukung, ID tracker yang tetap digunakan sebagai satu unit operasional. Asumsi ini tidak membuktikan identitas fisik dan tidak memperbaiki ID switch. Relasi duplicate/component yang didukung dari run tersimpan dapat digunakan kembali dengan kontrol aslinya; tidak ada algoritme asosiasi identitas atau model appearance baru pada eksperimen ini. Grouping duplicate memerlukan graph clique yang didukung dan tidak mempunyai pasangan internal yang unresolved.
+
+Overlap bbox saja tidak otomatis menahan atau menggabungkan kendaraan. Dua kendaraan yang berdekatan tetap dua unit. Konflik duplicate yang secara eksplisit tersimpan tetap dapat membuat passage pending. Jalur occlusion atau timeout tidak membuktikan dua ID adalah kendaraan yang sama.
+
+## 3. Tiga jalur dan prioritas bukti
+
+Satu unit/passage mempunyai satu event aktif. Urutan prioritas bukti adalah `LINE_MARGIN` → `OCCLUSION_DIFF_POLYGON` → `ESTIMATED_TIMEOUT`. Prioritas ini mengatur klasifikasi dan rekonsiliasi bukti, bukan tiga penjumlahan untuk passage yang sama.
+
+### 3.1 Garis dengan margin
+
+Log yang diminta: `ID-KATEGORI; A_TO_B/B_TO_A; CROSSING_LINE`.
+
+- Kendaraan harus mempunyai pengukuran pada sisi asal dan kemudian pada sisi berlawanan di luar margin. Kehadiran pertama di pita, menyentuh garis, berhenti, atau masuk pita lalu kembali tidak langsung menghasilkan +1.
+- Crossing terukur memerlukan bukti perpindahan sisi melalui interior segmen terbatas dari pengukuran berurutan. Kontak pada endpoint atau crossing pada perpanjangan garis tidak menjadi crossing finite yang terukur. Kontak tepat pada garis hanya sah sebagai bagian trajectory yang benar-benar berpindah sisi; kontak saja tidak cukup.
+- Jika kendaraan teramati di pita lalu hilang dan muncul di polygon tujuan dengan ID yang sama, jalurnya tetap `LINE_MARGIN` sesuai prioritas pengguna. Interval hilang tetap disimpan; `measured_crossing=false` jika kontinuitas bukti crossing/konfirmasi tidak ada. Label jalur garis tidak menyatakan momen crossing terlihat langsung.
+- Jika dua frame berurutan melompati seluruh pita tetapi segmen antar-BC memotong interior garis, crossing terukur dapat diterima tanpa sampel BC tepat di pita. Sumber kategorinya dicatat sebagai fallback endpoint, bukan kategori yang diamati di pita.
+
+### 3.2 Polygon berbeda setelah occlusion
+
+Log yang diminta: `ID-KATEGORI; A_TO_B/B_TO_A; OCCLUSION_DIFF_POLYGON`.
+
+- Kendaraan teramati di polygon asal, mempunyai interval frame tanpa pengukuran, lalu muncul di polygon tujuan.
+- Tidak ada BC kendaraan yang teramati di pita pada passage tersebut. Jika ada, jalur garis mendapat prioritas.
+- ID mentah, kategori endpoint, serta arah gerak harus konsisten. Arah didukung perpindahan pengukuran menuju sisi tujuan; gerak yang berbalik tidak dianggap arah yang sama.
+- ID baru tidak dihubungkan secara spekulatif ke ID yang hilang. Perpindahan raw track saat passage tetap unresolved meskipun caller mengenal group unit.
+- Jalur ini menambah satu hitungan operasional, dengan `measured_crossing=false`. Kedatangan di polygon tujuan merupakan bukti perpindahan ROI setelah gap; momen crossing segmen tidak diobservasi langsung.
+
+### 3.3 Timeout otomatis 60 frame
+
+Log menampilkan label yang diminta `CHANGE_ID` serta penanda `ESTIMATED_TIMEOUT`. Label `CHANGE_ID` tidak berarti pergantian ID terbukti; `id_change_proven=false` tetap disimpan.
+
+**REQUIREMENT — klarifikasi timer pengguna, persis:** **“Sejak terakhir terlihat di polygon asal”.**
+
+- Clock dimulai ulang pada setiap pengukuran di polygon asal, termasuk ketika kendaraan berhenti. Event dapat terbit pada indeks frame sumber `last_observed_origin_frame + 60` jika semua syarat lain masih terpenuhi.
+- Frame adalah indeks frame sumber, bukan jumlah observasi track. Konversi ke detik mengikuti FPS sumber; jangan menganggap seluruh video tepat 30 FPS.
+- Harus ada bukti gerak menuju garis dan belum ada pengukuran di polygon tujuan. Kendaraan yang hanya muncul sekali atau tidak mempunyai arah pendekatan yang dapat ditentukan tidak otomatis mendapat arah faktual.
+- U-turn sebelum menyentuh pita, dengan ID yang sama dan gerak berlawanan, membatalkan eligibility timeout. Gerak diukur dari perubahan signed distance terhadap garis; belum ada threshold smoothing/jitter baru yang dikalibrasi.
+- Kendaraan yang masih terlihat di asal terus memperbarui clock. Tidak muncul di tujuan saja tidak membuat kendaraan yang sedang diam dihitung pada 60 frame sejak pertama masuk.
+- Hanya frame yang benar-benar ada diproses. Akhir video tidak ditambah 60 frame fiktif; timer yang belum jatuh tempo tidak dipaksa menghasilkan event.
+- Event ini **otomatis +1 sesuai keputusan pengguna**, tetapi merupakan estimasi operasional. Arah asal→tujuan dicatat sebagai asumsi pada event timeout; timeout sendiri tidak membuktikan crossing, pergantian ID, atau kendaraan fisik yang sama dengan ID lain.
+
+## 4. Kategori di sekitar crossing
+
+**REQUIREMENT — pengguna:** utamakan ID dan tipe kendaraan ketika BC berada pada garis beserta margin.
+
+**ENGINEERING CHOICE — eksplisit untuk eksperimen ini:** setiap pengukuran kendaraan di dalam pita memberikan satu vote kategori mentah. Kategori dengan jumlah vote terbanyak menjadi kategori passage; seri tetap pending. Tidak ada persentase, confidence threshold, atau bobot temporal baru yang disisipkan.
+
+Jika tidak ada pengukuran BC di pita, kategori origin dan destination harus cocok. Untuk timeout, gunakan kategori pengukuran asal dan pengukuran terakhir yang sesuai; sumber fallback disimpan. Bukti pita yang muncul setelah timeout dapat mengganti kategori estimasi pada event yang sama.
+
+Cakupan kategori otomatis eksperimen ini adalah `motorcycle`, `car`, dan `truck`. Konflik kategori, vote seri, atau taxonomy yang belum didukung tetap pending. `bus` tidak diam-diam dipetakan ke angkot; pickup/minivan dan kategori bisnis lain tetap memerlukan keputusan terpisah.
+
+## 5. Deduplikasi, genuine return, dan revisi offline
+
+**REQUIREMENT — pengguna:** genuine return yang menghasilkan passage nyata boleh dihitung lagi. Setelah A→B selesai, lintasan baru B→A dapat menjadi event berikutnya. Izin tersebut tidak berarti jitter, pergantian cabang keputusan, atau kemunculan kembali dari satu passage dihitung ganda.
+
+- Kunci passage mengikat unit dan urutan passage dalam source/policy namespace yang reproducible.
+- Timeout yang kemudian memperoleh bukti arrival/crossing diperbarui pada event yang sama; increment rekonsiliasi adalah 0.
+- Jika bukti berikutnya membantah timeout—misalnya return/U-turn sebelum crossing, konflik identitas, atau kategori yang belum terselesaikan—hasil offline dapat membatalkan estimasi dan menyimpan log koreksi −1.
+- Event final, log perubahan, cancelled event, dan pending dipertahankan. Agregasi final berasal dari event aktif yang accepted; log +1/−1 tidak dijumlahkan lagi dengan event final.
+- B v1, B v2, dan hasil reviewed adalah snapshot terpisah; tidak dijumlahkan menjadi satu subtotal.
+
+Finalisasi tetap offline setelah replay video selesai. Panel menunjukkan replay ledger offline beserta lognya, bukan janji latensi atau reliabilitas sistem online.
+
+## 6. Output dan batas modul
+
+Implementasi notebook tetap berada di bawah `notebooks/`, tanpa refactor Phase 10 atau UI produksi:
+
+- [phase_8_b_v2_counting.py](../notebooks/phase_8_b_v2_counting.py): state/passage ledger murni dari frame pengukuran terverifikasi; entry point `replay_frames(...)`.
+- [phase_8_b_v2_batch.py](../notebooks/phase_8_b_v2_batch.py): validasi donor run, deteksi-source linkage, geometri, grouping retained, dan replay terpisah.
+- [phase_8_b_v2_annotation.py](../notebooks/phase_8_b_v2_annotation.py): gambar bbox unit, raw vehicle BC, pita, pivot, dan log passage.
+- [08b_counting_b_v2_replay.ipynb](../notebooks/08b_counting_b_v2_replay.ipynb): entry point Kaggle CPU untuk konfigurasi, validasi, replay cache, dan annotated video.
+- [policy.json](../results/b_v2/config/policy.json): margin, timer, category policy, serta asumsi eksperimen yang eksplisit.
+
+Output replay dipisahkan dari hasil historis. Simpan event aktif, cancelled event, pending/decisions, passage log, subtotal kategori/arah/jalur, input/config hashes, dan laporan eksekusi. Setiap event memuat frame aktivasi/keputusan, raw vehicle measurement references, kategori dan basisnya, gap, route, serta flag crossing terukur/inferensi.
+
+**Batas perbandingan pending:** B v2 mengagregasikan satu keputusan pending per unit/passage dengan kumpulan alasannya. Sebanyak 1.825 pending B v1 adalah kandidat/diagnostik geometri, termasuk diagnostik gap, bukan unit/passage fisik yang unik. Kedua angka memakai penyebut berbeda dan tidak boleh dipakai langsung untuk menyatakan persentase penurunan pending. Kehadiran awal tanpa bukti passage dan trajectory yang belum selesai pada EOF tetap dilaporkan melalui counter serta `open_passage_diagnostics`; kasus tersebut tidak diam-diam diartikan nol kendaraan atau seluruhnya dihitung sebagai pending. Audit tetap perlu memeriksa kendaraan yang tidak pernah menghasilkan kandidat/event.
+
+Pada annotated video, **log kendaraan lewat berada di bawah bagian passage accepted dan di atas pending**. Log memuat ID, kategori, arah, label jalur, frame, dan perubahan hitungan. Subtotal tiap jalur menjaga kontribusi timeout terlihat. Bbox gabungan tidak mengganti penanda BC kendaraan mentah.
+
+Folder tingkat atas `results/` tetap menjadi pintu masuk hasil dan indeks unduhan. Video besar dapat dipublikasikan sebagai release asset dengan tautan dari folder tersebut; sumber video asli tidak dimasukkan ke Git.
+
+## 7. Validasi dan batas klaim
+
+Uji sintetis memeriksa finite band, kontak tanpa crossing, endpoint/perpanjangan, gap, kategori pita, timeout tepat waktu, stationary clock reset, U-turn, upgrade/cancellation, genuine return, rider +0, dan deduplikasi known unit. Uji perangkat lunak tidak mengukur counting accuracy.
+
+Replay awal menggunakan cache Phase 8 yang sudah ada; detector, tracker, ReID, dan encoder tidak perlu dijalankan ulang. Kode atau notebook yang selesai dibuat tidak membuktikan replay delapan video telah selesai.
+
+Hal yang masih membutuhkan bukti: kesesuaian geometri temporal delapan video, salah gabung/duplikasi fisik, stabilitas kategori, akibat jitter pada arah/U-turn, hitungan timeout yang benar/salah, kendaraan yang tidak mempunyai track/kandidat, biaya pemrosesan, serta perbandingan passage fisik B v1 dan B v2. Tidak ada ground-truth dataset; penurunan pending atau kenaikan total operasional saja tidak membuktikan peningkatan reliabilitas.

+"""B v2 audit rendering from retained measurements and a completed event ledger.
+
+No detector, tracker, encoder, association or counting inference occurs here.
+The sidebar replays the explicit event log, including upgrades and reversals;
+its total is operational and contains inferred passages separately identified.
+"""

+from bisect import bisect_right
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict

+import json
+import math

+import subprocess

+import phase_8_annotation_helpers as frozen

+VERSION = "phase8_b_v2_annotation_v1"
+SEMANTICS = "OFFLINE_LEDGER_LOG_REPLAY_NOT_AN_ONLINE_DECISION_OR_ACCURACY_MEASUREMENT"
+CATEGORIES = ("motorcycle", "car", "truck")
+DIRECTIONS = ("A_TO_B", "B_TO_A")
+ROUTE_LABELS = {"LINE_MARGIN": "CROSSING_LINE",
+                "OCCLUSION_DIFF_POLYGON": "OCCLUSION_DIFF_POLYGON",
+                "ESTIMATED_TIMEOUT": "CHANGE_ID (ESTIMASI)"}
+_require = frozen._require
+
+
+def _identity(identity):
+    _require(isinstance(identity, dict), "Result source_identity is required")
+    for key in ("video_sha256", "records_sha256", "parent_run_id", "variant"):
+        frozen._identifier(identity.get(key), "source identity " + key)
+    for key in ("width", "height"):
+        frozen._integer(identity.get(key), key, 1)
+    _require(identity["variant"] == "raw", "B v2 renderer needs raw source measurements")
+
+
+def build_timeline(result, *, frame_count=None, component_relations=None):
+    """Validate one source ledger and compile constant-size counter snapshots.
+
+    Changes in route/category revise the same event; count_delta does not
+    accumulate duplicate passage counts. Cancelled events can appear during
+    replay before their explicit -1 cancellation even though final totals omit
+    them. Input objects are not modified.
+    """
+    identity = result.get("source_identity")
+    _identity(identity)
+    if frame_count is not None:
+        frozen._integer(frame_count, "frame_count", 1)
+    events, cancelled = result.get("events", []), result.get("cancelled_events", [])
+    _require(isinstance(events, list) and isinstance(cancelled, list), "Event arrays required")
+    by_id, final_ids = {}, set()
+    for event in events + cancelled:
+        _require(isinstance(event, dict), "Event must be an object")
+        event_id = frozen._identifier(event.get("event_id"), "event ID")
+        _require(event_id not in by_id, "Duplicate event ID")
+        _require(event.get("source_identity") == identity, "Event belongs to another source")
+        frozen._identifier(event.get("physical_unit_id"), "physical unit")
+        frozen._identifier(event.get("passage_id"), "passage")
+        frozen._integer(event.get("track_id"), "vehicle track", 1)
+        _require(event.get("category") in CATEGORIES, "Unsupported product category")
+        _require(event.get("direction") in DIRECTIONS, "Invalid event direction")
+        _require(event.get("route") in ROUTE_LABELS, "Unknown event route")
+        measured = event.get("evidence", {}).get("measured_crossing")
+        _require(type(measured) is bool, "Event requires explicit measured_crossing evidence")
+        _require(event["route"] == "LINE_MARGIN" or measured is False,
+                 "Polygon/timeout cannot claim a measured line crossing")
+        by_id[event_id] = deepcopy(event)
+        if event in events:
+            _require(event.get("accepted_count_event") is True,
+                     "Final event must explicitly contribute to the operational count")
+            _require(event.get("status") == "accepted", "Pending cannot enter accepted ledger")
+            final_ids.add(event_id)
+    final_passages = [(by_id[key]["physical_unit_id"], by_id[key]["passage_id"]) for key in final_ids]

+    route_counts = {route: 0 for route in ROUTE_LABELS}

+                       direction=payload["direction"], route=payload["route"],

+        snapshots.append({"pivot": deepcopy(pivot), "route_counts": dict(route_counts),

+                          "inferred_so_far": len(active) - measured})

+    for event_id in final_ids:
+        for key in ("category", "direction", "route", "track_id"):
+            _require(active[event_id][key] == by_id[event_id][key],
+                     "Final log/ledger differs: " + key)
+        _require(active[event_id]["_measured_crossing"] == by_id[event_id]["evidence"]["measured_crossing"],

+    pending = []
+    decisions = result.get("decisions", result.get("machine_decisions", []))
+    _require(isinstance(decisions, list), "Decisions must be an array")
+    for decision in decisions:

+        frame = decision.get("frame_index", decision.get("diagnostic", {}).get("frame_index"))

+        if frame_count is not None:

+    links = defaultdict(list)
+    for relation in relations:
+        _require(relation.get("type") == "COMPONENT_OF", "Only explicit component relations may merge display boxes")
+        vehicle = frozen._integer(relation.get("vehicle_track_id"), "component parent", 1)
+        component = frozen._integer(relation.get("component_track_id"), "component track", 1)

+def timeline_at(timeline, frame_index):
+    frozen._integer(frame_index, "frame index")
+    if timeline["frame_count"] is not None:
+        _require(frame_index < timeline["frame_count"], "Frame outside source")
+    position = bisect_right(timeline["operations"], frame_index)
+    pending_n = bisect_right(timeline["pending_frames"], frame_index)
+    state = deepcopy(timeline["snapshots"][position - 1]) if position else {
+        "pivot": {category: {direction: 0 for direction in DIRECTIONS} for category in CATEGORIES},
+        "route_counts": {route: 0 for route in ROUTE_LABELS}, "accepted_so_far": 0,
+        "measured_so_far": 0, "inferred_so_far": 0}
+    state.update(frame_index=frame_index, accepted_final=timeline["final_accepted"],
+                 pending_so_far=pending_n, pending_final=timeline["final_pending"],
+                 recent_logs=list(reversed(timeline["display_logs"][max(0, position - 4):position])),
+                 recent_pending=list(reversed(timeline["pending"][max(0, pending_n - 2):pending_n])))

+def _geometry_native(geometry, width, height):

+    _require((native.get("width"), native.get("height")) == (width, height),

+"""CPU replay of frozen Phase 8 measurements under the user's B v2 policy.
+
+The old model run, events, annotation tools and geometry remain immutable.
+New geometry, accepted estimates and route logs use a separate output namespace.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from collections import defaultdict
+from copy import deepcopy
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import gzip
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+import platform
+import sys
+import time
+
+import phase_8_annotation_batch as donor
+import phase_8_annotation_helpers as retained
+from phase_5_geometry_helpers import Geometry
+
+
+CONFIG = "results/b_v2/config"
+VEHICLES = {"motorcycle", "car", "truck", "bus"}
+SOURCE_NAMES = ("phase_8_b_v2_batch.py", "phase_8_b_v2_counting.py", "phase_8_b_v2_annotation.py",
+                "phase_5_geometry_helpers.py", "phase_8_annotation_batch.py", "phase_8_annotation_helpers.py")
+
+
+def _json(path, value):
+    path = Path(path)
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
+
+
+def _bound(root, name, digest):
+    path = donor._relative_path(root, name)
+    donor._require(path.is_file() and donor.sha256_file(path) == digest,
+                   "B v2 input bytes differ: " + name)
+    return path
+
+
+def prepare_b_v2_batch(*, repo_root, source_run_root=None, source_video_root=None,
+                       input_root="/kaggle/input", video_ids=None):
+    """Prove the exact original run before binding new, separate geometry."""
+    prepared = donor.prepare_annotation_batch(repo_root=repo_root, source_run_root=source_run_root,
+        source_video_root=source_video_root, input_root=input_root, video_ids=video_ids)
+    root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
+    manifest = donor._read(root / CONFIG / "geometry_manifest.json")
+    policy = donor._read(root / CONFIG / "policy.json")
+    donor._require(manifest.get("schema_version") == "phase8_b_v2_geometry_manifest_v1",
+                   "Unknown B v2 geometry manifest")
+    template = _bound(root, manifest["template_path"], manifest["template_sha256"])
+    donor._require(policy.get("source_template_sha256") == manifest["template_sha256"],
+                   "Policy/template binding mismatch")
+    donor._require(policy.get("timeout_frames") == 60 and policy.get("timeout_clock") == "last_observed_origin"
+        and policy.get("line_margin_half_width_px") == 25, "User's declared timeout/margin changed")
+    donor._require(policy.get("category_policy") == "band_majority_ties_pending", "Undeclared category policy")
+    geometries = {item["video_id"]: item for item in manifest["videos"]}
+    donor._require(len(geometries) == len(manifest["videos"]) == 8 and set(geometries) == set(donor.VIDEO_IDS),
+                   "B v2 needs eight explicit, unique source bindings")
+    for job in prepared["jobs"]:
+        entry = geometries[job["video_id"]]
+        identity = deepcopy(job["source_identity"])
+        donor._require(entry["video_sha256"] == identity["video_sha256"]
+            and (entry["width"], entry["height"]) == (identity["width"], identity["height"]),
+            "Shared template assigned to wrong source")
+        path = _bound(root, entry["geometry_path"], entry["geometry_sha256"])
+        geometry = donor._read(path)
+        donor._require(geometry["user_template"]["sha256"] == manifest["template_sha256"]
+            and geometry["source_video"]["sha256"] == identity["video_sha256"]
+            and geometry["line_margin_half_width_px"] == policy["line_margin_half_width_px"],
+            "Derived geometry/source/margin differs")
+        Geometry.from_draft(path, identity["width"], identity["height"])
+        identity.update(geometry_sha256=entry["geometry_sha256"])
+        job.update(b_v2_geometry_path=path, b_v2_source_identity=identity)
+    prepared.update(policy=policy, template_path=template,
+        geometry_manifest_sha256=donor.sha256_file(root / CONFIG / "geometry_manifest.json"),
+        policy_sha256=donor.sha256_file(root / CONFIG / "policy.json"))
+    return prepared
+
+
+def retained_relationships(path):
+    """Reuse supported old relations; no new appearance/spatial association.
+
+    Whole-ID grouping is explicitly experimental: supported raw-ID graph
+    components must be cliques and must not have an unresolved internal pair.
+    Ambiguous SAME_VEHICLE support is retained locally as a count conflict.
+    """
+    components, edges, ambiguous = [], set(), set()
+    conflicts = defaultdict(set)
+    for relation in retained.iter_json_array(path):
+        kind, status = relation.get("type"), relation.get("status")
+        if kind not in ("COMPONENT_OF", "SAME_VEHICLE") or status not in ("SUPPORTED", "UNRESOLVED"):
+            continue
+        first, second = relation["first_track_id"], relation["second_track_id"]
+        frames = relation.get("features", {}).get("common_frame_indices", [])
+        donor._require(type(first) is int and type(second) is int and first > 0 and second > 0
+            and first != second and isinstance(frames, list) and frames
+            and all(type(f) is int and f >= 0 for f in frames), "Invalid retained relation support")
+        if kind == "COMPONENT_OF" and status == "SUPPORTED":
+            components.append({"type": "COMPONENT_OF", "relation_id": relation["relation_id"],
+                "vehicle_track_id": second, "component_track_id": first,
+                "support_frames": sorted(set(frames))})
+        elif kind == "SAME_VEHICLE":
+            pair = frozenset((first, second))
+            if status == "SUPPORTED":
+                edges.add(pair)
+            else:
+                ambiguous.add(pair)
+                for frame in frames:
+                    conflicts[frame].update((first, second))
+    graph = defaultdict(set)
+    for pair in edges - ambiguous:
+        first, second = sorted(pair)
+        graph[first].add(second); graph[second].add(first)
+    visited, units, groups = set(), {}, []
+    for first in sorted(graph):
+        if first in visited:
+            continue
+        todo, members = [first], set()
+        while todo:
+            current = todo.pop()
+            if current in members:
+                continue
+            members.add(current); todo.extend(graph[current] - members)
+        visited.update(members)
+        if any(frozenset((a, b)) not in edges - ambiguous for a in members for b in members if a < b):
+            continue
+        group = sorted(members)
+        unit = "retained-clique:" + ",".join(map(str, group))
+        units.update({track: unit for track in group}); groups.append(group)
+    return {"component_links": components, "unit_by_track": units,
+            "unit_groups": groups, "identity_conflicts_by_frame": dict(conflicts)}
+
+
+def adapted_frames(path, identity, frame_count, *, relationships=None):
+    """Read actual source-linked emitted boxes, preserving every empty frame."""
+    relations = relationships or {}
+    units = relations.get("unit_by_track", {})
+    conflicts = relations.get("identity_conflicts_by_frame", {})
+    count = 0
+    for record in retained._records(path):
+        frame = record.get("frame_index")
+        donor._require(type(frame) is int and frame == count, "B v2 source frames must start at zero and be continuous")
+        for key in ("video_sha256", "parent_run_id", "variant", "width", "height"):
+            donor._require(record.get(key) == identity.get(key), "Source cache identity differs: " + key)
+        raw, tracks = record.get("raw_detections"), record.get("emitted_tracks")
+        donor._require(isinstance(raw, list) and isinstance(tracks, list), "Missing raw/source tracks")
+        seen, indices, observations = set(), set(), []
+        for observation in tracks:
+            track, index = observation.get("track_id"), observation.get("original_detection_index")
+            donor._require(type(track) is int and track > 0 and track not in seen
+                and type(index) is int and 0 <= index < len(raw) and index not in indices,
+                "Repeated or invalid emitted source link")
+            seen.add(track); indices.add(index)
+            donor._require(observation.get("frame_index") == frame and observation.get("emitted") is True
+                and observation.get("measurement_provenance") == "retained_phase_8_detection",
+                "Only retained measured emitted track observations can count")
+            box = retained._bbox(observation.get("raw_bbox")); detection = raw[index]
+            donor._require(0 <= box[0] < box[2] <= identity["width"]
+                and 0 <= box[1] < box[3] <= identity["height"], "BBox outside source image")
+            donor._require(box == detection.get("bbox_xyxy_pixels")
+                and all(observation.get(k) == detection.get(k) for k in ("class_name", "class_id", "confidence")),
+                "Track measurement differs from original detection")
+            confidence = observation.get("confidence")
+            donor._require(isinstance(confidence, (float, int)) and not isinstance(confidence, bool)
+                and math.isfinite(confidence), "Missing finite source confidence")
+            if observation["class_name"] not in VEHICLES:
+                continue
+            item = deepcopy(observation)
+            item.update(observed=True, identity_conflict=track in conflicts.get(frame, set()))
+            if track in units:
+                item["unit_id"] = units[track]
+            observations.append(item)
+        yield {"frame_index": frame, "observations": observations}
+        count += 1
+    donor._require(count == frame_count, "Full B v2 source cache frame count differs")
+
+
+def _retention(directory):
+    artifacts = []
+    for path in sorted(Path(directory).rglob("*")):
+        if path.is_file() and path.name != "retention_manifest.json":
+            artifacts.append({"path": path.relative_to(directory).as_posix(),
+                "sha256": donor.sha256_file(path), "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size})
+    _json(Path(directory) / "retention_manifest.json", {"schema_version": "phase8_b_v2_retention_v1", "artifacts": artifacts})
+
+
+def _source_snapshot(output):
+    """Retain exact executable bytes, separately from scientific donor inputs."""
+    directory = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    result = {}
+    for name in SOURCE_NAMES:
+        path = directory / name
+        data = path.read_bytes()
+        archive = output / "source_snapshot" / (name + ".gz")
+        archive.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        archive.write_bytes(gzip.compress(data, mtime=0))
+        result[str(path)] = {"sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "size_bytes": len(data),
+            "retained_path": archive.relative_to(output).as_posix()}
+    _json(output / "source_snapshot.json", result)
+    return result
+
+
+def run_b_v2_batch(*, repo_root, output_root="/kaggle/working/results/phase_8_b_v2",
+                   source_run_root=None, source_video_root=None, input_root="/kaggle/input",
+                   video_ids=None, render=True, progress=print, run_id=None):

+    report = {"schema_version": "phase8_b_v2_batch_v1", "run_id": identifier,

+        "output_directory": str(output), "selected_video_ids": prepared["selected_video_ids"],
+        "all_eight_selected": prepared["all_eight_selected"], "videos": [],
+        "policy": prepared["policy"], "policy_sha256": prepared["policy_sha256"],
+        "geometry_manifest_sha256": prepared["geometry_manifest_sha256"],
+        "baseline_run_id": donor.DONOR_RUN_ID, "baseline_accepted": donor.EXPECTED_ACCEPTED,
+        "baseline_pending": donor.EXPECTED_PENDING, "original_model_caches_modified": False,
+        "baseline_selected_accepted": sum(job["expected_pivot"]["accepted_total"] for job in prepared["jobs"]),
+        "baseline_selected_pending": sum(job["expected_pending"] for job in prepared["jobs"]),
+        "pending_semantics": "B_V2_UNIT_PASSAGE_DECISIONS_NOT_BASELINE_GEOMETRY_DIAGNOSTIC_ITEMS",
+        "changed_factors": ["geometry", "eligibility", "category_window", "gap_routes", "automatic_timeout"],
+        "executed_source_files": sources,
+        "new_detector_tracker_reid_execution": False, "new_counting_policy_replay": True,
+        "physical_identity_or_counting_accuracy_established": False,
+        "python": platform.python_version(), "render_requested": bool(render)}
+    _json(output / "batch_report.json", report)
+    started = time.perf_counter()
+    try:
+        for job in prepared["jobs"]:
+            video_id = job["video_id"]
+            target = output / video_id; target.mkdir()
+            row = {"video_id": video_id, "status": "running"}; report["videos"].append(row)
+            geometry_data = donor._read(job["b_v2_geometry_path"])

+    distance = signed_distance(point, p1, p2)

+    result = {"track_id": track, "class_name": category, "raw_bbox": [x - 2, y - 4, x + 2, y],
+              "original_detection_index": detection, "observed": True, "emitted": True}
+    if unit is not None:

+def frames(samples, *, end=None):
+    """samples maps actual source frame index to observations or a single y."""
+    end = max(samples) if end is None else end
+    result = []
+    for frame in range(end + 1):
+        value = samples.get(frame, [])
+        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+            value = [observation(value)]
+        result.append({"frame_index": frame, "observations": value})
+    return result
+
+

+# B v2 — geometri pengguna, counting dan log passage
+
+**Status 18 Oktober 2026:** kode dan replay CPU lokal delapan video selesai; annotated video sedang dijalankan dalam [notebook Kaggle B v2](https://www.kaggle.com/code/chrisbiran/phase-8-tgdi-b-v2-review). Status terminal dan tautan video aktual akan dicatat setelah output tersedia. Eksekusi baru memakai cache model Phase 8 yang sudah selesai, tanpa inference YOLO/BoT-SORT/ReID ulang.
+
+[Notebook sumber](../../notebooks/08b_counting_b_v2_replay.ipynb) · [Kontrak yang diterapkan](../../docs/B_V2_COUNTING_CONTRACT.md) · [Geometri delapan video](config/geometry_manifest.json) · [Policy eksplisit](config/policy.json) · [Input asli pengguna](input/TGDI-WEEKDAY-PAGI-geometry-review.json)
+
+Geometri native 640×480 memakai margin 25px per sisi (pita 50px). Clock 60 frame dimulai ulang setiap pengukuran di polygon asal. Jalur garis, polygon setelah occlusion tanpa sampel pita, serta timeout estimasi mempunyai log berbeda. Passage balik yang sah boleh dihitung lagi; upgrade bukti satu passage tidak menambah event kedua. Motorcycle+rider menjadi satu bbox tampilan ketika relasi komponen didukung, dengan BC kendaraan mentah tetap sebagai anchor.
+
+## Hasil replay lokal aktual
+
+Seluruh 72.590 frame direplay dari cache yang SHA-nya terverifikasi. Total operasional **3.717** terdiri dari **898 crossing terukur dan 2.819 inferensi**. Berdasarkan jalur: **1.024 LINE_MARGIN** (termasuk 126 yang crossing-nya tidak terlihat kontinu), **26 OCCLUSION_DIFF_POLYGON**, dan **2.667 ESTIMATED_TIMEOUT**. Angka ini hasil aturan yang diminta, belum jumlah kendaraan fisik yang tervalidasi. Kontribusi timeout yang besar perlu diaudit; penambahan event otomatis tidak membuktikan peningkatan akurasi.
+
+| Video | Operasional | Terukur | Inferensi | Timeout | Pending unit/passage |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| weekday_pagi | 526 | 137 | 389 | 371 | 17 |
+| weekday_siang | 613 | 122 | 491 | 465 | 102 |
+| weekday_sore | 466 | 116 | 350 | 328 | 40 |
+| weekday_malam | 394 | 83 | 311 | 285 | 6 |
+| weekend_pagi | 440 | 121 | 319 | 308 | 15 |
+| weekend_siang | 477 | 136 | 341 | 333 | 11 |
+| weekend_sore | 493 | 129 | 364 | 352 | 49 |
+| weekend_malam | 308 | 54 | 254 | 225 | 4 |
+
+Pending B v2 adalah keputusan per unit/passage. Angka 244 tidak dapat dibandingkan langsung sebagai persentase perbaikan terhadap 1.825 diagnostik/kandidat B v1. Kasus kehadiran awal tanpa bukti passage atau yang belum selesai di akhir video tetap ada dalam open_passage_diagnostics, bukan disembunyikan sebagai nol. Semua snapshot B v1 tetap terpisah.
+
+[Ringkasan aktual lokal](execution/local_replay_summary.json) dan arsip byte laporan/event beserta source_snapshot berada di execution/. Manifest retensi mengikat bytes asal dan gzip tersimpan. Ini bukan eksperimen ablation satu faktor: geometri dan beberapa aturan counting berubah bersamaan.
+
+## Preview aktual panel baru
+
+- [Crossing garis, frame 110](previews/TGDI-WEEKDAY-PAGI-LINE_MARGIN-frame-110.png)
+- [Occlusion polygon, frame 326](previews/TGDI-WEEKDAY-PAGI-OCCLUSION_DIFF_POLYGON-frame-326.png)
+- [Timeout estimasi, frame 76](previews/TGDI-WEEKDAY-PAGI-ESTIMATED_TIMEOUT-frame-76.png)
+
+Preview berasal dari frame TGDI aktual dan hasil B v2, dengan hash pixel sumber diperiksa. Log berada **di bawah passage accepted dan di atas pending**. Panel memisahkan measured/inferred, jalur LINE/POLYGON/TIMEOUT, ID/kategori/arah, serta revisi +0/pembatalan −1. Label CHANGE_ID pada timeout tetap ditandai estimasi; pergantian ID tidak dianggap terbukti.
+
+## Menjalankan ulang di Kaggle
+
+Notebook khusus CPU dipaketkan melalui:
+
+```bash
+python results/b_v2/verification/build_kaggle_bundle.py --repo-root . --output-dir /tmp/phase8-bv2-kaggle
+```
+
+Paket tidak berisi video, cache model, bobot, atau kredensial. Sumber Kaggle yang ditambahkan adalah dataset chrisbiran/tgdi-traffic-videos dan output notebook chrisbiran/phase-8-tgdi-full-video-research. Default VIDEO_IDS=None memproses delapan video; ['weekday_pagi'] menjalankan subset yang dilabeli subset. Output baru berada di /kaggle/working/results/phase_8_b_v2/<run_id>/.
+
+Untuk cache lokal yang sudah diunduh dan diverifikasi:
+
+```bash
+python notebooks/phase_8_b_v2_batch.py --repo-root . --source-run-root /path/to/original/run --source-video-root /path/to/TGDI/videos --output-root /path/to/new/results
+```
+
+Jangan arahkan output ke input lama. Source/model caches diverifikasi sebelum replay; output run yang sudah ada tidak ditimpa. Hasil partial/error mempertahankan laporan dan tidak dinyatakan selesai.
+
+## Validasi
+
+Tiga suite menghitung 45 uji counting, 25 uji renderer, 15 uji batch; seluruh 85 lulus tanpa skip. Pengujian mencakup timeout/return, rekonsiliasi event, finite endpoints, sumber BC, kategori pita, raw detection linkage, bbox rider, dan encode/decode H.264 sintetis. Validasi packaging menguji 22 guard dan source 30 file. Uji ini memverifikasi software; tidak mengukur counting accuracy. Publisher terpisah mempunyai 20 uji offline dan tidak menjalankan ulang pipeline.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build a private CPU Kaggle B v2 replay packet without uploading or running it.
+
+Only explicit Python/notebook/configuration evidence is packaged. Original
+model measurements and raw videos remain read-only Kaggle inputs. B v2 writes
+a separate counting experiment; it never rewrites the immutable B v1 donor.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations

+import argparse

+import base64
+from copy import deepcopy
+import gzip
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path

+
+

+NEW_GEOMETRY_MANIFEST = "results/b_v2/config/geometry_manifest.json"

+KERNEL_ID = "chrisbiran/phase-8-tgdi-b-v2-review"
+DONOR_MANIFEST_SHA256 = "79e8cf19747c63b34f8389d8f525925fd0c69e966f3d12ffb89716a5c89bd0dc"
+MAX_PACKET_BYTES = 1_000_000
+PYTHON_SOURCES = (
+    "notebooks/phase_8_b_v2_counting.py",

+    "notebooks/phase_5_geometry_helpers.py",
+    "notebooks/phase_8_annotation_helpers.py",
+    "notebooks/phase_8_annotation_batch.py",
+)
+FORBIDDEN_IMPORTS = frozenset(("ultralytics", "torch", "onnxruntime", "kaggle", "requests", "httpx"))
+EXPECTED_VIDEO_IDS = frozenset(f"{day}_{period}" for day in ("weekday", "weekend")
+                               for period in ("pagi", "siang", "sore", "malam"))
+SECRET_PATTERNS = (
+    re.compile(r"-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----"),
+    re.compile(r"\bgithub_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}"),
+    re.compile(r"\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}"),
+    re.compile(r"\bKGAT_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}"),
+    re.compile(r"https?://[^\s\"'<>]*(?:[?&](?:X-Goog-Signature|X-Amz-Signature|token|access_token)=)", re.I),
+)
+
+
+def sha(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def canonical(value):
+    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
+
+
+def safe_relative(value):
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
+        raise ValueError("Explicit packaged relative path required")
+    path = Path(value)
+    if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts or "\\" in value or path.as_posix() != value:
+        raise ValueError("Unsafe package path")
+    return path
+
+
+def read_source(repo, name):
+    path = repo / safe_relative(name)
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(repo) or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError("Packaged source missing or outside repository: " + name)
+    if path.suffix not in (".py", ".json", ".ipynb"):
+        raise ValueError("Only explicit source/configuration may be bundled")
+    data = path.read_bytes()
+    text = data.decode("utf-8")
+    if any(pattern.search(text) for pattern in SECRET_PATTERNS):
+        raise ValueError("Credential or signed capability detected in packaged source: " + name)
+    return data
+
+
+def cell_source(cell):
+    source = cell.get("source", [])
+    return "".join(source) if isinstance(source, list) else source
+
+
+def check_python(source, filename):
+    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=filename)
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        modules = []
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+            modules = [item.name for item in node.names]
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
+            modules = [node.module or ""]
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.Call) and node.args and isinstance(node.args[0], ast.Constant):
+            function = node.func
+            dynamic = ((isinstance(function, ast.Name) and function.id == "__import__")
+                       or (isinstance(function, ast.Attribute) and function.attr == "import_module"))
+            if dynamic and isinstance(node.args[0].value, str):
+                modules = [node.args[0].value]
+        if any(module.split(".")[0] in FORBIDDEN_IMPORTS for module in modules):
+            raise ValueError("B v2 packet must not import model/network runtimes: " + filename)

+def bootstrap_cell(payload, binding):
+    source = r'''# Exact hash-bound B v2 source extraction; no model or counting execution here.
+from pathlib import Path

+"""Offline publisher guards: fixtures never upload or download remote assets."""

+def fixture():
+    payload = {"source_commit": "d" * 40, "downloads": [
+        {"video_id": video_id, "url": f"https://www.kaggleusercontent.com/synthetic/{video_id}.mp4?token=fixture"}
+        for video_id in publisher.VIDEO_IDS]}
+    frames = (9052, 9128, 9077, 9022, 9017, 9124, 9138, 9032)
+    assets = []
+    for video_id, count in zip(publisher.VIDEO_IDS, frames):
+        day, period = video_id.split("_")
+        assets.append({"video_id": video_id, "filename": f"TGDI-{day.upper()}-{period.upper()}-b-v2-annotated.mp4",
+                       "size_bytes": 100, "sha256": "a" * 64, "frame_count": count,
+                       "source_output_path": f"/kaggle/working/synthetic/{video_id}/annotated.mp4",
+                       "operational_total": 5, "measured_total": 2, "inferred_total": 3})
+    manifest = {"schema_version": "phase8_b_v2_delivery_v1", "repository": publisher.REPOSITORY,
+                "source_commit": "e" * 40, "assets": assets,
+                "executed_source_files": [{"path": name, "sha256": "b" * 64}
+                                          for name in sorted(publisher.REQUIRED_SOURCE_FILES)]}
+    return payload, manifest
+
+
+class ManifestGuards(unittest.TestCase):
+    def reject(self, change):
+        payload, manifest = fixture()
+        change(payload, manifest)
+        with self.assertRaises(publisher.PublicationError):
+            publisher.validate_payload_manifest(payload, manifest)
+
+    def test_delivery_commit_can_differ_from_executed_commit(self):
+        payload, manifest = fixture()
+        delivery, executed, plan = publisher.validate_payload_manifest(payload, manifest)
+        self.assertNotEqual(delivery, executed)
+        self.assertEqual(len(plan), 8)
+        self.assertEqual(sum(row["frame_count"] for row in plan), 72590)
+
+    def test_input_objects_not_modified(self):
+        payload, manifest = fixture()
+        original = deepcopy((payload, manifest))
+        publisher.validate_payload_manifest(payload, manifest)
+        self.assertEqual((payload, manifest), original)
+
+    def test_wrong_repository_rejected(self):
+        self.reject(lambda p, m: m.update(repository="other/repository"))
+
+    def test_short_dispatch_sha_rejected(self):
+        self.reject(lambda p, m: p.update(source_commit="abcdef0"))
+
+    def test_mismatched_executed_commit_alias_rejected(self):
+        self.reject(lambda p, m: m.update(executed_source_commit="f" * 40))
+
+    def test_bad_mp4_sha_rejected(self):
+        self.reject(lambda p, m: m["assets"][0].update(sha256="not-a-sha"))
+
+    def test_unsafe_filename_rejected(self):
+        self.reject(lambda p, m: m["assets"][0].update(filename="../../anything.mp4"))
+
+    def test_missing_or_duplicate_video_rejected(self):
+        self.reject(lambda p, m: p["downloads"].pop())
+        self.reject(lambda p, m: m["assets"][1].update(video_id=m["assets"][0]["video_id"]))
+
+    def test_operational_breakdown_must_reconcile(self):
+        self.reject(lambda p, m: m["assets"][0].update(inferred_total=4))
+
+    def test_boolean_is_not_a_frame_count(self):
+        self.reject(lambda p, m: m["assets"][0].update(frame_count=True))
+
+    def test_signed_url_cannot_enter_retained_manifest(self):
+        self.reject(lambda p, m: m.update(unexpected_url=p["downloads"][0]["url"]))
+
+    def test_executed_source_set_and_hashes_are_required(self):
+        self.reject(lambda p, m: m["executed_source_files"].pop())
+        self.reject(lambda p, m: m["executed_source_files"][0].update(sha256="c" * 63))
+
+    def test_url_scope_and_transport_guards(self):
+        for url in ("http://www.kaggleusercontent.com/a", "https://example.com/a",
+                    "https://www.kaggleusercontent.com.evil.test/a",
+                    "https://www.kaggleusercontent.com:443/a", "https://u:p@www.kaggleusercontent.com/a",
+                    "https://www.kaggleusercontent.com/a#fragment", "https://www.kaggleusercontent.com/a\ncommand"):
+            with self.subTest(url=url):
+                with self.assertRaises(publisher.PublicationError):
+                    publisher.validate_url(url)
+
+    def test_urls_masked_before_use_and_percent_escaped(self):
+        output = io.StringIO()
+        with patch("sys.stdout", output):
+            publisher.validate_url("https://www.kaggleusercontent.com/a?token=a%2Fb", mask=True)
+        self.assertIn("::add-mask::https://www.kaggleusercontent.com/a?token=a%252Fb", output.getvalue())
+
+    def test_http_redirects_never_followed(self):
+        self.assertIsNone(publisher.NoRedirects().redirect_request(None, None, 302, "redirect", {}, "https://example.com"))
+
+
+class SourceAndAssetGuards(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_publication_receipt_uses_final_urls_and_distinct_commit_bindings(self):
+        payload, manifest = fixture()
+        content = b"synthetic completed MP4"
+        for asset in manifest["assets"]:
+            asset.update(size_bytes=len(content), sha256=hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest())
+        delivery, executed, plan = publisher.validate_payload_manifest(payload, manifest)
+        state = {"created": False, "draft": True, "assets": {}, "target": None, "uploaded_receipt": None}
+        lock = __import__("threading").Lock()
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            work = Path(directory)
+            manifest_path = work / "source_manifest.json"
+            publisher.write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
+
+            def remote_snapshot():
+                rows = []
+                for record in state["assets"].values():
+                    row = dict(record)
+                    tag = "untagged-draft-fixture" if state["draft"] else publisher.TAG
+                    row["browser_download_url"] = f"https://github.com/{publisher.REPOSITORY}/releases/download/{tag}/{row['name']}"
+                    rows.append(row)
+                return {"id": 123, "tag_name": publisher.TAG, "draft": state["draft"],
+                        "target_commitish": state["target"], "assets": rows,
+                        "html_url": f"https://github.com/{publisher.REPOSITORY}/releases/tag/{publisher.TAG}",
+                        "published_at": None if state["draft"] else "2026-10-18T00:00:00Z"}
+
+            def api(endpoint, *, method="GET", body=None, allow_missing=False):
+                if "/releases?" in endpoint:
+                    return []
+                if "/releases/tags/" in endpoint or "/git/ref/tags/" in endpoint:
+                    return None
+                if endpoint.endswith("/commits/" + publisher.TAG):
+                    return {"sha": executed}
+                if endpoint.endswith("/releases") and method == "POST":
+                    state.update(created=True, target=body["target_commitish"])
+                    return remote_snapshot()
+                if endpoint.endswith("/releases/123"):
+                    if method == "PATCH":
+                        state["draft"] = body["draft"]
+                    return remote_snapshot()
+                self.fail("Unexpected mocked endpoint")
+
+            def command(arguments, **kwargs):
+                self.assertEqual(arguments[:4], ["gh", "release", "upload", publisher.TAG])
+                path = Path(arguments[4])
+                with lock:
+                    state["assets"][path.name] = {"id": len(state["assets"]) + 1, "name": path.name,
+                        "state": "uploaded", "size": path.stat().st_size, "digest": "sha256:" + publisher.sha256(path)}
+                    if path.name == "publication_receipt.json":
+                        state["uploaded_receipt"] = json.loads(path.read_text())
+                return ""
+
+            def download(item, destination):
+                (destination / item["filename"]).write_bytes(content)
+                return {"video_id": item["video_id"], "filename": item["filename"], "size_bytes": len(content),
+                        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(), "download_url_or_secret_retained": False}
+
+            with patch.object(publisher, "api", side_effect=api), patch.object(publisher, "command", side_effect=command), \
+                 patch.object(publisher, "download_one", side_effect=download), patch.dict("os.environ", {"GITHUB_RUN_ID": "99"}), \
+                 patch("sys.stdout", io.StringIO()):
+                publisher.publish(work, manifest_path, manifest, plan, delivery, executed, work,
+                                  {"status": "UPLOAD_AUTHORIZATION_VERIFIED"})
+            receipt = state["uploaded_receipt"]
+            self.assertFalse(state["draft"])
+            self.assertEqual(len(state["assets"]), 11)
+            self.assertEqual(state["target"], executed)
+            self.assertEqual(receipt["delivery_source_commit"], delivery)
+            self.assertEqual(receipt["executed_source_commit"], executed)
+            self.assertNotIn("untagged-", json.dumps(receipt))
+            self.assertNotIn("kaggleusercontent", json.dumps(receipt))
+            self.assertTrue(all("/download/" + publisher.TAG + "/" in row["browser_download_url"]
+                                for row in receipt["assets"] + receipt["supplemental_assets"]))
+
+    def test_distinct_delivery_commit_binds_unchanged_executed_files(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            root = Path(directory)
+            def git(*args):
+                return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(root), *args], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).decode().strip()
+            git("init")
+            git("config", "user.name", "Synthetic test")
+            git("config", "user.email", "synthetic@example.invalid")
+            files = []
+            for name in sorted(publisher.REQUIRED_SOURCE_FILES):
+                path = root / name
+                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+                path.write_text("# synthetic source\n")
+                files.append({"path": name, "sha256": publisher.sha256(path)})
+            git("add", ".")
+            git("commit", "-m", "Synthetic executed source")
+            executed = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
+            (root / "delivery.txt").write_text("Later retained evidence\n")
+            git("add", ".")
+            git("commit", "-m", "Synthetic later delivery")
+            delivery = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
+            with patch.object(publisher, "api", return_value={"sha": executed}):
+                publisher.verify_source_binding(root, delivery, executed, {"executed_source_files": files})
+            (root / files[0]["path"]).write_text("# changed after execution\n")
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(publisher.PublicationError, "source SHA differs"):
+                publisher.verify_source_binding(root, delivery, executed, {"executed_source_files": files})
+
+    def test_existing_draft_rejected_before_any_upload(self):
+        with patch.object(publisher, "api", return_value=[{"tag_name": publisher.TAG, "draft": True}]) as mocked:
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(publisher.PublicationError, "draft already exists"):
+                publisher.require_unused_tag(publisher.TAG)
+        self.assertEqual(mocked.call_count, 1)
+
+    def test_server_digest_mismatch_rejected(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            path = Path(directory) / "video.mp4"

+    def test_successful_transport_record_never_retains_capability(self):

+                "url": "https://www.kaggleusercontent.com/a?token=fixture", "size_bytes": len(data),
+                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory, patch.object(publisher, "build_opener", return_value=Opener()):
+            record = publisher.download_one(item, Path(directory))
+            self.assertEqual((Path(directory) / item["filename"]).read_bytes(), data)
+        self.assertNotIn("token=fixture", json.dumps(record))
+        self.assertNotIn("kaggleusercontent", json.dumps(record))
